subject: Co-sell demo: multi-host rotation & blocked windows
messages:
From: Timothy Banks <tim.banks@cloudwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@bluepeaksi.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo planning - can we do a multi-host run?

Hey Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick connect last week. CloudWave is excited to get a joint demo scheduled — we have a few stakeholders that need to present (security & platform leads) and our SI partner BluePeak wants to show integration flow.

High level ask: can we run a single 90-minute session that rotates hosts (Redwood technical + BluePeak SI + CloudWave product) across three 20-25 minute segments, then leave 20 minutes for Q&A + roadmap? We also want to ensure the Marketplace listing team (AWS Marketplace) has a pre-demo checklist completed before the run.

Constraints: prefer US mornings (PDT) the week of Aug 9–13, and we need to lock calendar blocks today if possible.

Can you propose blocked windows and confirm you can include a short runbook for the hosts?

Thanks,
Tim
Timothy Banks
Partnerships, CloudWave Solutions
Attachment: None
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo planning - can we do a multi-host run?

Hi Tim — looping in our co-sell ops and SE leads (Vanessa, Vivek, Karthik). Thanks for the ask — we can absolutely do the three-segment host rotation, and I agree a 90-minute session with 20 min Q&A is the right format.

Proposed blocked windows (US PDT):
- Tue Aug 10: 09:00–10:30
- Wed Aug 11: 10:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 12: 08:30–10:00

Action items I can take today:
- Share a lightweight host runbook (attached v2) with slide flow + roles.
- Produce a calendar .ics with provisional invites for the three windows (attaching).
- Coordinate with AWS Marketplace for the pre-demo checklist — @AWS Marketplace, any required items to review ahead of time?

Vanessa/Vivek: can you confirm availability for the Aug 10/11/12 windows and whether we need an additional technical dry-run (30 min) with BluePeak?

Thanks — attaching: redwood-runbook-v2.pdf and a provisional co-sell calendar (.ics).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo planning - can we do a multi-host run?

Jonas / team — thanks for the slots. Quick pragmatic notes from an ops perspective:

- Host rotation order: Redwood SE (platform intro, infra/fallbacks) -> BluePeak SI (integration + provisioning) -> CloudWave PM (product/roadmap). That order minimizes context switching for infra topics.
- We should reserve a 30-minute dry-run one business day before the demo with all hosts + one AWS Marketplace rep to validate any Marketplace demo flow (procurement/subscribe flow).
- For the main session, suggest we split the 90 minutes as 25 / 25 / 20 + 20 Q&A to keep it tight.
- Requesting we publish the runbook slides 48 hrs prior. Put a versioned filename so the SI and CloudWave can reference (I've added v2 already).

I am available for Aug 10 & 11 morning windows — Aug 12 is tight for me. Vivek/Karthik, can you pick your primary/backup for each slot?

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Co-sell Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: runbook-notes.txt (inline in Drive)
From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@bluepeaksi.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Banks <tim.banks@cloudwave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo planning - can we do a multi-host run?

Thanks Jonas / Vanessa — BluePeak can do the Aug 10 and Aug 11 windows. A few notes from SI side:

- We have a GCP networking engineer who needs to demo a cross-cloud connector; she is only available Aug 11 (10–11:30 slot is perfect). If you want the GCP piece included, can we make Aug 11 the primary?
- We prefer the dry-run on Aug 10 (PDT) at 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PDT for 30 minutes. That gives us time to iterate before the Aug 11 main run.
- Small ask for the runbook: include exact slide references where the SI will take live terminal or console time (so we can coordinate SSH/console access and masking).

Also tagging AWS Marketplace — Marketplace rep, please confirm whether we need a separate pre-demo Marketplace checklist call or if the dry-run is sufficient for compliance/subscribe demo validation.

Best,
Priya Raman
Director, Systems Integration, BluePeak SI

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Aug 11 primary + pre-demo dry-run confirmed

All — finalizing per availability:

- Main co-sell demo: Aug 11, 2027, 10:00–11:30 PDT (primary host order: Redwood SE -> BluePeak SI -> CloudWave PM).
- Dry-run: Aug 10, 2027, 09:00–09:30 PDT (30 minutes) — required for host handoffs and Marketplace validation.
- Calendar invites: I've sent the provisional invite and included a 30-min buffer after the dry-run for last-minute checks. Please accept or propose an alternative by EOD Aug 3.

Action items assigned:
- @Vivek Kulkarni: lead the dry-run—coordinate console access and masking, confirm infra fallback scripts.
- @Karthik Iyer: manage breakout slide deck and timing cues; prepare timestamps in the runbook where BluePeak gets console time.
- @Vanessa Ortiz: publish a final runbook (redwood-runbook-v2_FINAL.pdf) 48 hrs prior and share on the Drive link.
- @AWS Marketplace: confirm whether the dry-run suffices for the marketplace pre-demo validation or if you need an additional checklist call.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CoSellRunbooks (runbook + host slides)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DW-4821

If there are any show-stoppers (procurement gating, legal redlines, or additional SI requirements) flag them now so we can escalate. Otherwise we will proceed with the two confirmed slots.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth run.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
